title: Vision Plans: Eligibility on the Date of Service, Filing Limits and Network Channel
content:
**Claims payability under the Vision Plans** turns on three things: whether coverage was in force on the date of service, when the claim was received, and the network channel of the provider.

**1. Coverage on the date of service.** A service is payable only if the enrollment was active on its date of service, meaning on or after the coverage effective date and on or before any termination date. Otherwise it is denied as not eligible. Services with a date of service while the funding billing account is in its grace period are adjudicated normally. If the account then lapses with a paid-through date before the date of service, the paid service is reversed.

**2. Filing limits.** A claim must be received within the plan's in-network filing limit (participating provider) or out-of-network filing limit (member-submitted), counted in calendar days after the date of service. A later claim is denied for timely filing. For a participating provider the member owes nothing for it.

**3. Network channel.** The network channel is fixed by the provider's agreement in force on the date of service — its effective date on or before that date, and its termination date, if any, on or after it.

| Provider's agreement on the date of service | Network channel |
|---|---|
| A Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement in force, location type independent practice | In network, independent practice |
| A Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement in force, location type retail chain | In network, retail chain |
| Anything else | Out of network |

**Boundary illustrations (hypothetical dates).**
- With a 180-day in-network limit, a participating provider's claim for a 2 January service received 180 days later is in time; one received 181 days later is denied for timely filing, and the member owes nothing.
- An agreement whose termination date is 30 June still gives the in-network channel to a 30 June service; a 1 July service is out of network.
